title: 訓練量週增幅
description:
訓練量週增幅：近 4 週平均每週時數，比上一週的 4 週平均多幾 %。
怎麼看：長條 = 4 週平均週增幅；紅線 = +10%，灰線 = 0。
看什麼：連續 3 週以上超過 +10% 才要注意。只看趨勢，不是受傷預測。
方法：所有運動的移動時間，沒活動的週算 0；用 4 週平均，因為單週會被一次百岳或休息週放大好幾倍。10%：Uphill Athlete（平均每週 > 10%、持續約 8 週會出問題）。

series.name: 4 週平均週增幅
series.expression: (if(isvalid(sum(movingduration, startofweek(date))), sum(movingduration, startofweek(date)), 0) - shift(if(isvalid(sum(movingduration, startofweek(date))), sum(movingduration, startofweek(date)), 0), 28)) / if(shift(if(isvalid(sum(movingduration, startofweek(date))), sum(movingduration, startofweek(date)), 0), 7) + shift(if(isvalid(sum(movingduration, startofweek(date))), sum(movingduration, startofweek(date)), 0), 14) + shift(if(isvalid(sum(movingduration, startofweek(date))), sum(movingduration, startofweek(date)), 0), 21) + shift(if(isvalid(sum(movingduration, startofweek(date))), sum(movingduration, startofweek(date)), 0), 28) > 0, shift(if(isvalid(sum(movingduration, startofweek(date))), sum(movingduration, startofweek(date)), 0), 7) + shift(if(isvalid(sum(movingduration, startofweek(date))), sum(movingduration, startofweek(date)), 0), 14) + shift(if(isvalid(sum(movingduration, startofweek(date))), sum(movingduration, startofweek(date)), 0), 21) + shift(if(isvalid(sum(movingduration, startofweek(date))), sum(movingduration, startofweek(date)), 0), 28))
